paper.title: REFLECT: Summarizing Robot Experiences for Failure Explanation and Correction
paper.central_claim: Hierarchical multisensory robot-experience summaries and progressive LLM failure explanation enable more accurate failure diagnosis and effective executable correction planning, in simulation and real-world robot experiences.

evidence.quote: It contains three modules: a hierarchical robot summary module that summarizes multisensory robot data with three levels of abstraction (§ 3.1 ), a progressive failure explanation module that queries LLM to detect and explain the failure (§ 3.2 ), and finally a failure correction planner that generates an executable correction plan (§ 3.3 ). Fig 2: Hierarchical robot summary is composed of: a) a s
evidence.support_explanation: Three-stage static harness: multisensory serialization, progressive diagnosis, executable correction; no retained model improvement.

evidence.quote: Once a failure is detected, relevant environment information stored in the event-based summary or sensory-input summary can be retrieved for detailed failure explanation. 3.2 Progressive Failure Explanation The failure explanation a
evidence.support_explanation: Hierarchical detail retrieval is triggered by a failed subgoal, not an unbounded transcript.

evidence.quote: To make sure the plan generated by the language model is executable in the environment, we adopt the idea of Huang et al. [28] to map each LLM-generated action to its closest executable action in the task environment using a large pre-trained sentence embedding model.
evidence.support_explanation: Language actions are mapped to executable primitives; executability does not certify semantic correctness.

signatures.output: Failure type, time and natural-language explanation
signatures.conditions: Useful task-relevant perception and candidate state labels; mostly static surroundings
signatures.feedback: Recorded observations and LLM subgoal judgement, audited against annotated failures by humans
signatures.selection_rule: Failed subgoal selects detailed event/sensory retrieval; if all subgoals pass, compare final/goal states with original plan
signatures.data: 100 simulation and 30 real manually generated/teleoperated failure records
signatures.persistence: Within-experience summary and retrieved event history only
signatures.later_use: Correction prompt for same failed task; not a cross-task policy or retained harness edit
signatures.failure_boundary: Perception errors and inadequate low-level-control state; LLM explanations remain fallible

signatures.object: Failed task final state and correction plan
signatures.information: Original plan, generated explanation, final state, goal; oracle simulation state channel
signatures.operation: GPT-4 generates plan; sentence embeddings map each action to closest executable primitive; execute and check final goal
signatures.output: Corrective action sequence and task success
signatures.conditions: Environment action vocabulary covers the remedy; mapping is not semantic validation
signatures.feedback: Simulation final-state truth used for evaluation; diagnosis is not independently certified before every action
signatures.selection_rule: Nearest executable action mapping, not a learned acceptance gate
signatures.data: Same RoboFail simulation cases; no fresh post-selection holdout described
signatures.persistence: Episode correction only; no accepted edit library, retraining or RSI chain
signatures.claimed_effect: Explanation-guided recovery beyond replanning without explanation

gap.author_gap: Failure explanations require both task-level planning context and fine-grained multisensory evidence; prior feedback is often sparse, ground-truth, or attached to one/few actions.
gap.checked_gap: A real residual bottleneck is diagnosing extended failed robot histories for a correction planner. Supplied related work distinguishes dense captioning, Socratic Models and language-planning/feedback approaches, but their original fulltexts/versions are not fixed here.

assessment.evidence_level_reason: Simulation correction plans actually execute and are checked against environment goal truth. Real-world evidence is offline diagnosis of recorded failures; no transfer label.
assessment.strongest_supported_claim: GPT-4 hierarchical summaries improve diagnosis on RoboFail, and explanations improve simulation corrections under oracle perception.
unresolved: Real autonomous correction efficacy and robust perception
assessment.retained: not_applicable: static harness and within-task correction, not persistent accepted improvement
